schemas.description: Optional schema allowlist; default is every non-system schema.

ddl_files.description: ddl-file mode: SQL files, applied in listed order by psql inside the ephemeral container.

image.description: ddl-file mode: postgres container image. Required, no default — the image major MUST match the live target's major (pg_get_viewdef deparsing differs across majors and stats.definition is hash-included, so a mismatch manufactures spurious breaking diffs at the ddl-file->live switch, exactly what S-4 promises never happens). Customer 2: postgres:15.

dsn.description: live mode: connection string for a read-only role. Prefer dsn_env to keep secrets out of config files.

dsn_env.description: live mode: name of an environment variable holding the DSN.
